prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Sentinel Vale ground excludes spacecraft/launch/external-processing except interfaces. Mission Control Center(Bluebell):command/release authority,approved-role/time-limited elevated-access,continuous agreed-hours console-coverage/stateful handovers. Mission Planning System(Cedar)→Contact booking requests→Ground Network Manager(Juniper);metadata/command-preparation→Payload Processing Facility(Forgehouse)/Bluebell;Ephemeris Delta Note→schedule-validation/latest-constraints. Juniper→Antenna Deicing Notice→Spacecraft Operations Team;antenna-baseline acceptance requires current maintenance-clearances:North S-Band Antenna/South S-Band Antenna(command/telemetry),Kiruna X-Band Antenna/Svalbard X-Band Antenna(also tracking);recovery:availability/contact-priority. Command Validation Gateway(Osprey):independent validation;mask-integrity/configuration/operator-approval match security-baseline;maneuver screening/concurrence;reject commands lacking approved authorization,validation,operator-acknowledgment. Telemetry Ingest Service→validated/isolated/staged Pass Replay Packet→Spacecraft Operations Team:archived-context verification;integrated day-in-life rehearsal:preparation/commanding/telemetry/anomaly/recovery. Orbit Determination Engine→states/predictions/Doppler Residual Report/Laser Retroreflector Window(scheduling-constraint). Flight Dynamics Team→validated-tracking→Flight Dynamics Facility(Mistral)→ephemerides/events→Bluebell/Cedar/Forgehouse;demonstrate orbit-products/maneuver-screening/conjunction-coordination within planning-cycle;rehearse missing-tracking/late-updates. Payload Calibration Team:approve baselines/reprocessing;rehearsal-calibration/traceable engineering-criteria. Forgehouse:demonstrate sustained representative-contact processing,approved-actions-only manual-intervention. Network Control System(Lantern):approved-routing/logged-changes;Security Exception Ticket restricts transfers;record maintenance/station-loss/degraded-routing/outage-restoration rehearsals. Primary Processing Cluster→identical Backup Processing Cluster;both-unavailable:suspend/preserve/notify Bluebell;recovery:contractual-latency then acquisition-order unless approved;Backup verifies capacity using Storage Watermark Snapshot before standby. Product Quality Service:provenance/quality/public-status/reprocessing-reasons. Long Term Archive(Granite):authoritative raw/auxiliary/inputs/products/operational-metadata;admission:Forgehouse

New part:
S244: Operational key performance indicators include contact success rate, telemetry completeness, command validation timeliness, product latency, product quality disposition time, archive availability, help desk responsiveness, and unresolved anomaly age.
S245: Each key performance indicator has an assigned data source, sampling interval, review owner, threshold, and corrective action trigger so that routine reporting does not depend on informal judgment.
S246: The primary monthly service review compares actual performance against the accepted baseline and records trend explanations for any measure that moves outside the watch band.
S247: The Primary Processing Cluster and Backup Processing Cluster are baselined with approved software versions, processing configurations, capacity reservations, monitoring checks, and rollback instructions before handover.
S248: Configuration baselines for ground software, operational procedures, interface control data, account roles, and monitoring rules are frozen at readiness review entry and changed only through approved change control.
S249: Handover to routine mission service is authorized when acceptance evidence is complete, rehearsals meet their objectives, open risks are acknowledged by accountable owners, and support teams confirm on-call coverage.
S250: After handover, the first operational reporting cycle is treated as a stabilization period in which deviations are reviewed daily and permanent process changes are deferred until sufficient evidence is available.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
